text: dsh-pixel-crt 是一款面向 DSH 网页客户端的会话区主题插件。它在聊天区和输入区注入限定范围的 CSS，将界面改为深色底色、青绿色强调色、直角边框和像素风标题，并为按钮、代码块、引用、表格与滚动条添加硬边框和方块阴影。插件还会监听页面变化，检查会话区内浅色背景与浅色文字的组合并进行对比度修正。适合希望把 DSH 对话界面改成复古 CRT 像素风格的网页用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-pixel-crt adds a dark CRT pixel theme to the DSH web conversation pane. Scoped CSS gives chat and composer regions dark colors, cyan accents, square borders, pixel headings and scanlines. A page observer adjusts light-on-light combinations there. No API key or external service is needed.
想把 DSH 聊天窗口换成深色像素风主题
有没有办法让对话区看起来像复古 CRT 屏幕？
Give my DSH web chat a dark retro pixel look.
dsh-pixel-crt 的功能「会话区 CRT 像素主题」：插件加载后将深色配色、青色强调、直角边框、像素风标题和扫描线应用到聊天区与输入区，不改动侧栏等其他区域。
dsh-pixel-crt 的功能「动态对比度修正」：页面内容变化时会延迟扫描聊天区和输入区；遇到浅色底与浅色文字组合时，将背景或文字调整为深色主题色。

dsh-pixel-crt README · dsh-pixel-crt：A dark CRT pixel skin for the conversation pane of the DSH Web GUI — hard 2px borders, block shadows, bitmap headings, scanlines. Scoped to the chat and composer regions only; the sidebar, title bar and other panels are untouched.

> The screenshot is a demo render of the skin on a mock conversation, not a capture of a live session.

dsh-pixel-crt README · What it does：- Redefines the palette inside `[data-conversation-region="chat"]` and `[data-conversation-region="composer"]`: near-black surfaces, cyan accents, zero border radius. Components that read the `--dsw-alias-*` variables follow automatically.
- Adds the pixel furniture: 2px borders, `3px 3px 0` block shadows, pressed-state offset, flat code blocks, square scrollbars, cyan caret, pixel selection.
- Headings and buttons use a bitmap face (`Unifont` / `Zpix` / `WenQuanYi Zen Hei Sharp`, whichever is installed). Body text stays at the normal 14px and keeps the system font — bitmap faces at small sizes just turn to mush.
- Slight scanline overlay via a repeating gradient.

dsh-pixel-crt README · What it does not do：- It does not touch the sidebar or any panel outside the conversation.
- It does not change message layout, spacing or font size. Nothing moves; only the skin changes.
- It is a pure front-end bundle: no host routes, no config, no state, nothing written to disk.

dsh-pixel-crt README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add <this-repo-url>
```

or point the plugin manager at a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin install ./pixel-crt
```

Then reload the Web GUI. Uninstall by disabling or removing the `dsh-pixel-crt` bundle.

dsh-pixel-crt README · Why a contrast sweep：Some components hard-code their surfaces in local variables (`--deliverable-fill`) or `color-mix(#fff 50%, transparent)` instead of the alias tokens, so a dark palette leaves light cards with light text — usually a file name you can't read. The bundle runs a small, debounced sweep after each render: if an element sits on a light background *and* its text is light, the background is pushed dark. Dark surfaces and dark-on-light cards are never touched.

dsh-pixel-crt README · Known rough edges：- Small icon-only buttons look chunky at 2px.
- All headings collapse to one size (16px) — the bitmap face only reads cleanly on a 12/16px grid.
- Scanlines are one CSS rule; delete the `background-image` line if you don't want them.
